post_hoc_disclosure: The BULL component was generated after chronological visual review of all 3422 frozen 2014-2020 distributed-accumulation charts. The BEAR components were previously frozen development mechanisms. This union is a consumed-history development hypothesis, not independent confirmation.
economic_hypothesis: Positive absolute opportunity has different observable causes in different market states: genuine price discovery through a clear supply corridor in a strengthening BULL state, and active demand after fast capitulation or slow supply exhaustion in a BEAR state. A causal TRANSITION state provides neither premise and therefore remains cash.

causal_market_state.source: the exact already-frozen causal market-regime labels carried by each component
causal_market_state.BULL: both completed signal-date cross-sectional 20/60-session median returns and positive-return participation exceed their frozen zero/50-percent definitions
causal_market_state.BEAR: both completed signal-date cross-sectional 20/60-session median returns and positive-return participation are at or below their frozen zero/50-percent definitions
causal_market_state.TRANSITION: all other causal configurations; hold cash

frozen_routes.mechanism: confirmed distributed accumulation escaping through a clear target corridor while causal market return pace and participation strengthen
frozen_routes.target_and_horizon: +15 percent gross target / 30 held market sessions

frozen_routes.mechanism: fast capitulation followed by active demand
frozen_routes.target_and_horizon: +10 percent gross target / 20 held market sessions

frozen_routes.mechanism: slow selling-pressure exhaustion followed by demand takeover
frozen_routes.target_and_horizon: +10 percent gross target / 20 held market sessions

union_semantics.same_symbol_same_signal_date: keep BEAR fast capitulation before BEAR slow exhaustion; BULL and BEAR routes are mutually exclusive
union_semantics.weighting: event-level equal weight for the discovery gate; no portfolio sizing or overlapping-position optimization
union_semantics.transaction_cost: the net_return already carries the frozen 40 bps round-trip cost
union_semantics.T_plus_1_limits_suspensions_and_corporat: unchanged and binding in each frozen component
